# Java libraries, binaries and tests with Maven dependencies, through the
# binary: outputs pass between targets, a second run does nothing, a change
# reruns what depends on it, and a cleaned project restores from the cache.
[!exec:javac] skip

# A Maven repository on disk, with jars built here: a library, and a stand-in
# for the JUnit console launcher that java.maven adds beside JUnit's engine.
bit greeting console
cp greeting/build/greeting.jar repo/com/example/greeting/1.0/greeting-1.0.jar
cp greeting/build/greeting.jar repo/org/junit/platform/junit-platform-engine/1.0/junit-platform-engine-1.0.jar
cp console/build/console.jar repo/org/junit/platform/junit-platform-console/1.0/junit-platform-console-1.0.jar

bit
stdout 'deps ✔ ok'
stdout 'core-test ✔ ok'
stdout 'server ✔ ok'
grep '"org\.junit\.platform:junit-platform-console"' maven.lock.json
exec java -jar app/build/app/app.jar
stdout '\Ahello, world\n\z'

bit
! stdout '✔ ok'

cp Greeter.java.changed core/src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java
bit
stdout 'core ✔ ok'
stdout 'core-test ✔ ok'
stdout 'app ✔ ok'
stdout 'server ✔ ok'
! stdout 'deps ✔'
exec java -jar app/build/app/app.jar
stdout '\Ahi, world\n\z'

bit --clean
! exists core/build/core.jar
! exists app/build/app
bit
stdout 'restore'
exec java -jar app/build/app/app.jar
stdout '\Ahi, world\n\z'

-- BUILD.bit --
explicit greeting = java.library {
  dir = "greeting"
}

explicit console = java.library {
  dir = "console"
}

deps = java.maven {
  artifacts = [
    "com.example:greeting:1.0",
    "org.junit.platform:junit-platform-engine:1.0",
  ]
  repositories = ["file://#{project_dir()}/repo"]
}

core = java.library {
  dir   = "core"
  maven = ["com.example:greeting"]
  lock  = deps.lock
}

core-test = java.test {
  dir       = "core"
  classpath = core.classpath
  maven     = ["org.junit.platform:junit-platform-engine"]
  lock      = deps.lock
}

app = java.library {
  dir       = "app"
  classpath = core.classpath
}

server = java.binary {
  dir       = "app"
  classpath = app.classpath
}

</project>

  <version>1.0</version>
</project>

<project>
  <groupId>org.junit.platform</groupId>

  <version>1.0</version>
</project>
-- greeting/src/main/java/com/example/greeting/Greeting.java --
package com.example.greeting;

public class Greeting {
    public static String word() {
        return "hello";
    }
}
-- console/src/main/java/org/junit/platform/console/ConsoleLauncher.java --
package org.junit.platform.console;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

// Reports one passing test per compiled test class, as JUnit's launcher would.
public class ConsoleLauncher {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Path classes = null;
        Path reports = null;
        for (String arg : args) {
            if (arg.startsWith("--scan-class-path=")) classes = Paths.get(arg.substring(18));
            if (arg.startsWith("--reports-dir=")) reports = Paths.get(arg.substring(14));
        }
        StringBuilder xml = new StringBuilder("<testsuite>");
        Path root = classes;
        try (var files = Files.walk(root)) {
            files.filter(f -> f.toString().endsWith("Test.class")).forEach(f -> {
                String name = root.relativize(f).toString().replace(".class", "").replace('/', '.');
                xml.append("<testcase name=\"works()\" classname=\"").append(name).append("\"/>");
            });
        }
        Files.createDirectories(reports);
        Files.writeString(reports.resolve("TEST-junit-jupiter.xml"), xml.append("</testsuite>"));
    }
}
-- core/src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java --
package demo;

public class Greeter {
    public static String greet(String name) {
        return com.example.greeting.Greeting.word() + ", " + name;
    }
}
-- Greeter.java.changed --
package demo;

public class Greeter {
    public static String greet(String name) {
        return "hi, " + name;
    }
}
-- core/src/test/java/demo/GreeterTest.java --
package demo;

class GreeterTest {
}
-- app/src/main/java/demo/Main.java --
package demo;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println(Greeter.greet("world"));
    }
}
